thread:
lucas_finance: Heads-up — Helios Labs sent INV-3077 but invoice is issued by their subcontractor Solstice Services. PO PO-66011 is under Helios Labs only. AP couldn't auto-match vendor name -> moved to exceptions. Anyone seen subcontractor billing like this?
anya_procure: We have PO-66011 as a Blanket for Helios (Platform infra). Subcontractor billing usually needs subcontractor on the PO or a change order. Did vendor include any purchase order reference?
felix_ap: AP log: invoice references PO-66011 in description but vendor name = Solstice Services. System tried exact vendor match -> fail. Fallback fuzzy match suggested Helios Labs but because invoice 'from' differs we flagged vendor mismatch. Invoice INV-3077 now in exceptions. Link: https://ap.redwood.com/exceptions/INV-3077
ap_bot: Automated: Invoice INV-3077 placed in exceptions: vendor mismatch (Solstice Services vs Helios Labs). Required action: procurement confirmation or vendor reissue.
lucas_finance: Invoice snippet: ```
Vendor: Solstice Services (subcontractor)
Invoice: INV-3077
Amount: $9,850.00
PO: PO-66011 (mentioned in line items)
Lines: Integration testing support (40 hrs) $9,850
Tax: withholding not applied
```
vendor_bot: Solstice portal: "Solstice billed on behalf of Helios. We can reissue invoice under Helios Labs or attach subcontractor addendum. Let us know preference."
anya_procure: Procurement policy requires either: 1) prime vendor (Helios) to invoice and then remit to subcontractor, or 2) PO amendment listing subcontractor as approved vendor. We should ask Helios to reissue under their company name referencing PO-66011.
legal_zoe: Also check tax treatment: if Solstice is US sub and did not include tax withholding info, we need W-9/Tax form on file for Solstice. Can't pay without vendor tax verification for >$5k.
lucas_finance: Requestor confirms work done. Quick options: a) ask Helios to reissue and pay them, b) accept Solstice invoice if procurement issues a PO amendment and legal confirms tax docs. Which do we prefer to keep payment timely?
anya_procure: Prefer (a) to avoid PO changes. Can someone ping Helios and ask them to reissue invoice under their name and reference PO-66011? If they push back, we'll issue PO amendment.
felix_ap: I can hold invoice in exceptions and mark "AWAITING-REISSUE". If vendor takes too long, procurement can approve manual pay under TEMP-SUBPAY with documentation.
ap_bot: Automated: Status updated -> AWAITING-REISSUE. Reminder set for 7 days.
lucas_finance: I'll email Helios now and copy procurement + legal. Also attaching the invoice: https://drive.redwood.com/finance/invoices/INV-3077.pdf
vendor_bot: Helios portal message: "We will reissue the invoice under Helios Labs referencing PO-66011 within 3 business days. We'll provide subcontractor remittance details separately."
legal_zoe: Please ensure Solstice uploads W-9 (or W-8BEN if non-US) to vendor portal. We'll need tax form before final payment.
felix_ap: Noted. AP will not schedule payment until tax form is on file or until Helios reissues. Will change status to "Pending Vendor Reissue".
ap_bot: Automated: Invoice INV-3077 set to Pending Vendor Reissue. Follow-up reminder in 3 days.
lucas_finance: Thanks. Created FIN-3728 to track reissue and tax docs, and ticket PROC-1309 to capture PO amendment if needed. Links: https://issues.redwood.com/FIN-3728, https://issues.redwood.com/PROC-1309
vendor_bot: Helios: "Invoice reissued as INV-3077-R under Helios Labs and submitted to AP portal. Remittance schedule unchanged."
felix_ap: Found reissued invoice INV-3077-R. AP matched to PO-66011 and routed to approver @anya_procure. AP status: Pending Approval (anya_procure).
anya_procure: Approved. Confirmed Helios will handle subcontractor remittance. Please confirm Solstice tax form on file; if not, Helios must attest remittance.
legal_zoe: Solstice W-9 received and attached to vendor record. Legal ok.
felix_ap: Payment scheduled (net-30). AP note: payment to Helios Labs; Solstice remittance to be handled by Helios. Closing AP exception.
lucas_finance: Great, closing thread. Thanks everyone. Added vendor note: subcontractor invoices must route through prime vendor or be pre-approved on PO. :white_check_mark:
